statement: Suppose that the couplings are Gaussian. Fix ϑ > 0, an integer m ≥ 1, and 0 < ξ < 1/100. There are measurable disorder events Gn, a constant C < ∞, and deterministic εn ↓ 0 such that lim infn→∞ P(Gn) ≥ 1 − ϑ, and the following inequalities hold on Gn, for all sufficiently large n. The constant is independent of the initial law ρ, which may 32 be chosen after the disorder.
